name: Knight of Pestilence raises Pestilence critical damage via native SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (#811)
contract: Knight of Pestilence 704981 reads 'Increases the critical damage of your Pestilences by $s1%.' (rank text: 50%). Effect 0 is native aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), EffectMiscValue 15 -> SpellModOp::SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h:91), EffectBasePoints 99 with DieSides 1 -> 100, EffectSpellClassMask [0,0,512] (all verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc). SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS is consumed generically and unconditionally by the native engine at src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp:1579, :9961 and :9996 (modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spellInfo->Id, SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, crit_bonus)) -- the stock spell-mod system, applied to any spell whose family flags intersect the aura's classMask; nothing Xoroth-specific is required. The affected spell is Unleash Death 801055 (one of the class's per-spec 'Pestilence' unleash-damage spells, SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, DmgClass Magic, Fire school), whose own SpellFamilyFlags are {67108864,0,512} (verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc, a repo-wide scan for SpellFamilyName 23 spells carrying classMask dword2 bit 9), intersecting Knight of Pestilence's mask exactly. Unleash Pestilence 801002 (SpellFamilyFlags {0,65536,0}, the self-buff cast trigger, not a Pestilence-family damage spell) does not intersect the mask and serves as the regression control. spell_modifier submits no cast; it reads the player's live ApplySpellMod(spell, op, value) result, adding the aura's 100 percentage points onto a probe base.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no crit-damage bonus on Unleash Death before Knight of Pestilence
Force the Knight of Pestilence passive aura
SETUP: the Knight of Pestilence passive is active
CONTRACT: Unleash Death's crit damage bonus doubles (adds 100 points)
REGRESSION: Unleash Pestilence's own family mask is untouched
